# Razia Azeem Academy

> Live one-on-one online Quran classes for kids and adults in the UK, USA and Australia.
> Qualified male and female teachers. 7 courses. 3-day FREE trial. 10% sibling discount.

## Courses
1. Noorani Qaida — Arabic alphabet and pronunciation for beginners (kids 4+ and adults)
2. Nazra Quran — fluent Quran reading, Juz 1 to 30
3. Hifz-ul-Quran — full Quran memorization with Sabaq/Sabqi/Manzil revision system
4. Tajweed-ul-Quran — advanced recitation rules and Ijazah preparation
5. Islamic Studies for Kids — Seerah, Akhlaq, Kalimas, daily duas
6. Namaz & Masnoon Duas — Salah step by step with authentic supplications
7. Quran Translation — understand selected Surahs in easy English/Urdu

## Pricing (per month)
- USA: $35 (2x/week), $49 (3x/week), $79 (5x/week)
- UK: £28 (2x/week), £39 (3x/week), £59 (5x/week)
- Australia: AU$55 (2x/week), AU$79 (3x/week), AU$119 (5x/week)
- 10% sibling discount. 3-day free trial, no card required.

## Key facts
- Classes: 30 minutes, live one-on-one via video call, 7 days a week
- Teachers: background-checked, English-speaking, male and female available
- Timings: UK evenings (GMT/BST), USA evenings (EST-PST), Australia afternoons (AEST)
